## DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0

Initial macOS release of DSH Client.

- Bundles the pinned DeepSeek Harness Web runtime; no separate `dsh` or Node.js installation is required.
- Uses the official black DeepSeek Harness mark and the **DeepSeek Harness** application name.
- Keeps Harness sessions and settings in the existing local profile.
- Checks `fatwang2/dsh-client` GitHub Releases for signed automatic updates.
